history_description: Compare the monthly cost of your recurring subscriptions. Current estimates and saved monthly snapshots are shown separately.
history_no_previous: No record for the previous month
history_comparison_pending: A consecutive month is needed to compare.
history_unchanged: Your monthly subscription cost is unchanged.
history_chart_label: Monthly equivalent subscription costs by recorded month
history_first_month: This is your first recorded month. Your current cost is visible below; comparison becomes available when another month is recorded.
history_table_caption: Up to 12 recorded months. Missing months are not counted as zero.
history_empty: No monthly cost data yet. Add a subscription to see its monthly equivalent here.
history_explain_estimate: The live estimate uses active expense subscriptions: yearly subscriptions are divided by 12, weekly subscriptions are converted to a monthly equivalent, and income credits are excluded. This is a recurring cost estimate, not the amount actually paid.
history_explain_snapshot: Past rows show the subscription cost saved for that month. The server saves a snapshot on the first day of each month; “Save this month” updates the current month. Past snapshots are not recalculated when a subscription changes. Values are displayed in your main currency; older snapshots retain their original numeric value, so avoid comparing across a change of main currency.
history_explain_gaps: Only recorded months are shown. A missing month is not zero spending. Changes are compared only with the immediately preceding calendar month. No percentage is shown when the previous value was zero.
history_load_error: Saved history could not be loaded. The live estimate may still be available. Refresh the page to retry.
history_save_error: This month could not be saved. Please retry.
theme_save_error: Could not save your theme. Please retry.
budget_month_empty: No subscription charges are due this month.
budget_list_error: This month’s payments could not be loaded. Refresh to retry.
budget_month_note: Charges are grouped by their due month. Paid amounts come from payment records; other amounts are scheduled prices, converted to your main currency.
payments_load_error: Payment data could not be loaded. Refresh to retry.
payments_month_empty: There are no recorded payments in {{month}}. Select Planned to see scheduled charges.
payments_missing_amount: {{count}} payments have no recorded amount and are excluded from the total.
payments_paid_note: Paid totals use recorded amounts and payment dates. Income is excluded; currency conversion uses current rates.
statistics_payments_description: See costs by category and select a month to see which subscriptions were paid.
payments_month_unpriced: Payment records in {{month}} have no recorded amounts.
statistics_category_period_note: Estimated total for subscription charges due in the selected months, using current prices.

bulk_edit_hint: Bewerk elk geselecteerd item en sla de wijzigingen samen op.
bulk_partial_failure: {{count}} items konden niet worden verwerkt. De selectie blijft behouden om opnieuw te proberen.
statistics_category_no_upcoming: Geen komende betalingen in de geselecteerde periode.
